{{Top|leg}}
A '''plasma driller''' was a large bore [[Mining/Legends|mining]] tool. Plasma drillers were used to cut through the bedrock and hollow out the caverns below [[Fortress Baarlos]] on the orders of [[Faarl]] the Conqueror.
